description: SEC 10-K supply chain risk — Supply chain risk profile of a public company from its latest 10-K: manufacturing model (OUTSOURCED / IN_HOUSE / HYBRID), sole- or single-source supplier statements, contract manufacturers and foundries named (TSMC, Foxconn, Samsung...), sourcing countries, raw materials and commodities, tariff mentions, geopolitical flags (China-Taiwan, Russia-Ukraine, critical minerals) and a HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW risk heuristic. Uses Item 1 manufacturing/supply/raw-material sections plus supply sentences in Item 1A. ticker= required; optional filing=1 for the prior 10-K. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_supply_chain
